name: Omanode
author: jwhall
description: Join, leave and inspect ZeroTier networks from the Omarchy bar. Unofficial third-party widget for ZeroTier networks; not affiliated with ZeroTier, Inc.

barWidget.description: List joined ZeroTier networks, join/leave by network ID, and view each network's assigned address. Requires zerotier-one and a one-time polkit policy install (see README).
